remarks: Introducing Riverbank Landing!  Now over 90% Sold! An exciting live-work-play development nestled along the banks of the beautiful Sturgeon River Valley. Concrete and steel construction offers superior privacy and fire safety. This spacious (1,588 sf) corner 2 Bedroom plus Den suite offers premium features throughout including: 9 ft ceilings, oversized window walls on two sides, quartz countertops, plank and porcelain tile flooring, cozy linear fireplace, 451 sf wrap-around balcony with gas & water. Each suite has dedicated fresh-air supply, forced air heating and A/C! Includes underground parking and storage with the option to upgrade to a private double garage. Riverbank Landing's well designed amenities have your new lifestyle in mind with: an impressive 2 story lobby, spacious event centre, fitness/yoga room, owner's lounge with roof-top patio, guest suite, etc. Only steps to Mercato Italian Market, boutique shopping, restaurants, professional services and the tranquil Red Willow Trail system.
